headline: Gold Prices Fall Below $4,000, Facing Steepest Weekly Drop in Months
summary: Gold prices fell below $4,000 per ounce, putting the precious metal on track for its steepest weekly drop in over four months.
why: Precious metals serve as key safe-haven assets and inflation hedges, with price swings impacting mining equities and investor portfolios.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Selling pressure pushes spot bullion prices lower across global exchanges.

why_moved: Broader market liquidations and shifting macroeconomic expectations reduced safe-haven demand, accelerating profit-taking in precious metals.
